_comment: Fragment 40 — D-87, Lane A queue closed: G67, G68, G70, D-78 and D-77. Merged 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: D-87 — Lane A's Queue Closed, C-14 Now Nine Checks
nodes.description: Closes G67 by extending the shared-core hash to the 138-line preamble, G68 by mapping the Tier 1 Alpha Portfolio document, D-78 by repairing docs-drift to compare branch.json lastAnalyzedHead against HEAD, and G70 by adding source-sweep. D-77 is answered and struck rather than repaired. Nine checks run locally, six reach CI.
nodes.rationale: Every repaired or added check was negative-tested and restored. The frozen-document signal was tested by perturbing the pin rather than editing a frozen file, so the frozen set was never touched.

nodes.label: D-77 — agent-stats Fails on an Off-by-One Separator
nodes.description: repoSlug maps the repository root to C--git-my-editorial-app, which is exactly the transcript directory Claude Code writes. The filter then requires the directory name to start with that slug plus a hyphen, so dir equals slug is true while dir startsWith slug plus hyphen is false, and every transcript is skipped. An upstream defect in the installed distribution, not a setting on this side.
nodes.rationale: The claim was struck rather than worked around: patching a global npm install is not durable, the project forbids swapping distributions, and creating a sibling directory to satisfy the prefix would hide a defect instead of recording it. Attribution is now described as unavailable rather than merely unread.

nodes.label: The Repaired docs-drift Caught a Real Staleness Immediately
nodes.description: On its first live run after repair it reported the graph stale, analyzed at b120c72 while HEAD was 87e62ad. The previous implementation would have reported synced. The check is red between a commit and the next rebuild by design, because the graph genuinely is stale in that window.
nodes.rationale: A check that has never failed is not known to work. This one failed a deliberate negative test, was restored, and then caught a real instance within minutes without being prompted.

nodes.label: A Negative Test That Moved HEAD Destroyed Uncommitted Work
nodes.description: A negative test used git reset --hard while edits to tracked files were uncommitted, discarding the G67, G68 and D-78 changes and the runner wiring. All were redone from the same content and nothing was lost permanently, but the work was committed before continuing rather than carried further uncommitted.
nodes.rationale: Recorded as a procedure rule: negative tests that move HEAD must not run over a dirty tree. The earlier negative tests in the same session used file copies and were safe; the two that used reset were not.
